solver_notes: Native deterministic C11/pthreads regression model executed on the RAK Miner v2 aarch64 host. The legacy forced interleaving reproduces an unlocked SaveThread caller retaining a stale live-interpreter observation across deletion and touching a freed tstate. The fixed lane holds head_mutex across interpreter-list validation and tstate pinning, uses atomic acquire/release RMW for every refcount transition, rejects post-deletion saves, and frees only when the final owning reference drops. Two concurrent-thread stress runs each executed 10000 rounds with zero use-after-free attempts and final_refs=0. Scope: standalone native reproduction/fix for the stated lifecycle invariant, not a claimed patch to upstream CPython and not a claim that the torvalds/linux metadata names the correct upstream repository.

tests_run.command: gcc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pthread interpreter_lifecycle.c -o interpreter_lifecycle && ./interpreter_lifecycle legacy && ./interpreter_lifecycle fixed && ./interpreter_lifecycle stress && ./interpreter_lifecycle && python3 -m pytest -q test_frontier_0039.py
